name: 637. Deleting the Prometheus connector keeps telemetry off (TXE-7746)
description: The Prometheus connector on the observability page is the telemetry plugin, which also serves /metrics. The server loads telemetry at startup when it has no stored row (default-on, so upgraders keep /metrics), so DELETE /api/plugins/telemetry used to remove the row and stop /metrics only until the next restart. The delete now leaves a disabled row with an empty config. The rows run in order on the provider error fixture's gateway: check the gateway stores no telemetry row, store an enabled one (/metrics served), delete it, read back a disabled empty row (red before the fix: no row), check /metrics answers 404, then turn telemetry back on and check /metrics is served again. A restart cannot be driven from the harness; the disabled row is what loadBuiltinPlugins reads to keep telemetry off.
